criteria.name: Greeting
criteria.description: The agent opens professionally and establishes the purpose of the conversation.
criteria.pass_guidance: A clear greeting and relevant introduction or purpose are observable.
criteria.fail_guidance: The opening is abrupt, confusing, or omits both greeting and purpose.

criteria.name: Discovery
criteria.description: The agent asks useful questions to understand goals, needs, or current challenges.
criteria.pass_guidance: The agent asks and follows up on substantive need or goal questions.
criteria.fail_guidance: The agent pitches without adequately exploring the customer's situation.

criteria.name: Qualification
criteria.description: The agent establishes relevant fit signals such as need, timing, authority, or constraints.
criteria.pass_guidance: The conversation establishes enough concrete fit information to guide a sales decision.
criteria.fail_guidance: Applicable fit questions are skipped or leave material qualification gaps.

criteria.name: Objection Handling
criteria.description: When an objection occurs, the agent acknowledges it and responds constructively.
criteria.pass_guidance: An expressed concern is acknowledged and answered with relevant, non-pressuring information.
criteria.fail_guidance: An expressed concern is ignored, dismissed, contradicted, or handled without relevance.

criteria.name: Closing
criteria.description: The agent makes an appropriate attempt to advance or conclude the sales conversation.
criteria.pass_guidance: The agent asks for a suitable commitment, booking, decision, or agreed conclusion.
criteria.fail_guidance: The call ends without an appropriate attempt to advance or clearly conclude it.

criteria.name: Clear Next Step
criteria.description: The conversation ends with an explicit owner and concrete next action or timing when follow-up is appropriate.
criteria.pass_guidance: A specific next action, owner, and timing are mutually clear, or the final disposition is explicit.
criteria.fail_guidance: The next action is vague, ownerless, missing timing, or absent despite being needed.
